title: Launchpad mini-hero storyboard and interactive step tiles
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design an alternative, compact hero for the Quickstart landing page that tells a concise onboarding story and surfaces interactive step tiles. The goal is to reduce initial vertical real estate while increasing discoverability of the next steps. Deliverables: hero storyboard (3 variants), micro-animation specs, interactive step-tile component (desktop & mobile), screenshot export templates and a lightweight asset package for front-end implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Three hero variants in Figma (Static / Micro-animated / Interactive preview) with clear dev tokens
Interactive step tiles: hover/focus states, keyboard navigation, and ARIA roles documented
Export-ready screenshots for desktop/tablet/mobile automated in the release pipeline
Performance budget guidance for hero assets (SVG/PNG size targets) and LCP target <= 1.0s on 3G simulated mobile
Design handoff artefacts and a working prototype link for QA and PM review
tasks: Kickoff with PM & Eng to align on constraints and data (03/02)
Sketch 6 micro-story ideas and select top 3 (03/04)
Accessibility audit: color contrast, keyboard flow, motion reduction setting (03/09)
Prepare screenshot automation templates & device frames (03/11)
Dev handoff: tokens, asset exports, CSS guidance (03/14)
Design review & iterate with PM, Eng, Research (03/16)
design_links: Proto: Interactive step tiles (keyboard + reduced motion)
dev_handoff_notes: Provide a single SVG hero with layered elements (background, device screen, content masks). Include Lottie JSON for micro-animations and a static fallback. Supply CSS variables for spacing and colors. Provide JS glue for interactive tile states but keep DOM semantic (button elements, aria-expanded, aria-controls). Supply screenshot export script: puppeteer script + config for device widths and theme variants.
review_feedback: PM: prefer shorter micro-story copy; suggest 2-line max for hero CTA
Eng: ask to reduce foreign asset weight, recommend rasterizing complex shadows to single PNG layer
Research: prototype test suggested users prefer visible next-step tiles over full-bleed hero
Accessibility: ensure 'prefers-reduced-motion' stops micro-animations and provides instant state changes
notes: This ticket experiments with a compact storytelling approach for Quickstart that will be A/B tested against the current hero. Keep copy configurable from CMS to allow rapid iterations. Include analytics hooks (data-track) on tile clicks and hero CTA.
